Questions & answers

Quick answers for buyers and sellers. Can't find yours? Ask us on WhatsApp.

For buyers

Does Yɛntɔn Online sell the products?

No. We advertise products for Ghanaian businesses. When you tap Contact seller on WhatsApp, you talk directly to the seller and buy from them.

How do I pay for something I want?

You agree the price, payment and delivery with the seller. We don't take payments for products, so never send money to anyone claiming to collect it for Yɛntɔn Online.

Is it safe to buy?

Most sellers are honest, but always see the item before you pay, meet in a busy public place, and check that it works. Look for the ✔ Verified badge, which means our team has checked the business. Read our safety tips.

A seller cheated me or didn't deliver. What do I do?

Tell us on WhatsApp with the seller's name and screenshots of your chat. We'll look into it and can remove the seller from our platform. For fraud, also report to the police. Sellers are responsible for their own sales, so we can't refund purchases.

I can't find what I'm looking for.

Use Find it for me. Tell us what you want and your budget, and our team will look for a seller.

Can I use the site in Twi?

Yes. Tap TWI at the top of any page. The main menus and buttons switch to Twi.

For sellers

How do I advertise my product?

Fill the short form on Advertise With Us, or just send photos, prices and your location to us on WhatsApp. We'll take it from there. See every step.

How much does it cost?

It depends on the package you choose and your ad budget. We agree the price with you on WhatsApp before anything starts. Our management fee is always shown separately from the money spent on Facebook and Instagram ads.

How do I pay?

By Mobile Money. Payment details are on the Packages page. Always use your business name as the reference and send us a screenshot.

Do you guarantee sales?

No one can honestly guarantee sales. We guarantee to promote your product as agreed and to share the results, such as how many people saw your ad and how many contacted you.

Who handles the buyers?

You do. Buyers contact you directly on WhatsApp or by phone, and you close the sale, collect payment and arrange delivery.

What can't I advertise?

Anything illegal in Ghana, fake or counterfeit goods, weapons, drugs, adult content, and get-rich-quick or investment schemes. See the full list in our advertising policy.

How do I get the Verified badge?

Ask us on WhatsApp. Our team checks that your business is real, for example by confirming your location, phone number and products.

Still have a question?
